svg.title: Grid approximation of the help desk posterior at three resolutions
svg.desc: Three panels over call rates from 2 to 8 per hour. Coarse grid bars are chunky and the tail probability is too small; the finest grid is indistinguishable from the exact Gamma density.
svg.text: Normalizing a grid: divide the cell values by their total so they sum to one
Black curve: the exact Gamma(shape 50, rate 10) posterior, whose exact P(lambda above 5.5) is 0.2322.
A coarse grid already reproduces the posterior mean of 5.0, but a tail probability needs resolution: 0.2275, then 0.2320, then 0.2322.
Refining costs almost nothing here because there is one parameter. That is exactly what stops being true in the next figure.
